question: Where can I find the closest university toward the north of J P Riddle Stadium, Fayetteville, NC?
sql:
WITH origin AS (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.909681 35.008472)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois,origin
WHERE pois.amenity = 'university'
AND ((degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 0.0 AND 22.5) OR (degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360))
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> origin.geometry ASC
LIMIT 1;

answers.operator: A Constituent Institution of the University of North Carolina

[2].display_name: J P Riddle Stadium, Fayetteville, NC

[3].direction_predicate: ((degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 0.0 AND 22.5) OR (degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360))
